title: Gods Elect People
author: Unknown
description: Gods Elect People, a handwritten notebook or manuscript of biblical study notes, preserved here as a scanned text with heavy OCR errors. Its opening lines take as their theme 'God's elect people' and refer to Isaiah ('the first and last'), God's deliverance of Israel from Pharaoh, the crossing of the Red Sea and related scripture, with many chapter-and-verse references, apparently assembling texts on the identity and destiny of Israel as God's chosen people. The author and date are not identified, and the garbled transcription makes detailed content hard to establish. It should be treated as a personal manuscript of uncertain origin; consult the PDF scan rather than the extracted text for accurate reading.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB). The PDF is a scan; the EPUB is derived from OCR text and its quality is limited—consult the PDF for the faithful page.
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
